$comment: SONAR MODULE (pack: sonar) — targets bizapps-sonar (schema __mj_BizAppsSonar). DEFINITIONS ONLY: Sonar is a live scoring engine (FactorCompiler compiles factors to SQL and computes scores), so we ship the model + published version + bands + related entities + factors + weights, and let Sonar recompute scores/contributions/history after install (do NOT pre-compute score rows — they can't match the engine and a Declarative factor without an executable definition won't compile). Factors mirror the working demo models: Declarative + Count over a single-hop related entity, RelationshipPath '[]' (compiler auto-resolves the FK path to the People anchor), MinMax normalization (engine derives min/max over the population), equal additive weights, WeightedSum → 0..100. Engagement = breadth/volume of real participation; a declining member scores below an active one because Sonar counts the actual rows. Slug 'morecheese-engagement' (unique; the demo clone owns other engagement slugs). Integration-grade: model owner is a platform-pack staff user, so INSTALL_ORDER puts sonar after platform.

model.name: Member Engagement Score
model.description: Composite engagement score for federation members — breadth of participation across events, governance, learning, advocacy, and surveys. The retention early-warning dial, computed live by Sonar.

bands.label: At Risk
bands.description: Disengaged — renewal is in doubt without intervention.

bands.label: Engaged
bands.description: Highly engaged — advocates and volunteers live here.

sonar.$factorNote: each factor = Count over a single-hop related entity (its PersonID/RespondentPersonID FK auto-resolves to the People anchor). Equal additive weights; Sonar's MinMax normalizes each factor over the member population, WeightedSum combines. All-time volume in v1 — recency windows (Factor.DateField + Rolling TimeWindow) are an easy follow-up.

factors.name: Committee Service
factors.description: How many committee memberships the member holds.

factors.name: Learning Activity
factors.description: How many courses the member has enrolled in.

factors.name: Advocacy Participation
factors.description: How many advocacy actions the member has taken.

factors.name: Survey Participation
factors.description: How many surveys the member has responded to.
